title: A guarded migration agent: tool scoping, approval gates and a planted injection
area: AI integration: tools, loop and security
scenario: The pod wants a migration agent that runs headless in CI, reads ClaimDesk and proposes patches that a reviewer approves. AppSec's condition: safety must not depend on the model behaving. The repository contains a contractor's note telling automated assistants to empty a test and print a secret.
task: Validate every tool call against its schema; one result per tool_use with actionable errors
Scope paths to the workspace, deny secret reads, allow writes only to src/main and pom.xml
Gate allowed writes on the reviewer; bound output size and turns; keep an audit trail
Explain why the guarantees hold even with a compromised model
acceptance: The planted-injection run with an approve-everything reviewer changes and leaks nothing
Path escapes, symlinks, secrets via search, unknown tools and invalid input all handled
Truncation marker, max_turns and a complete audit trail
ANSWER.md covers the lethal trifecta and CI hardening

practices.label: AI Integration - tool design and the agent loop
